cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've copied your red label onto all the plate boxes. Thank you for taking that whole job; you're wonderfully careful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Red means fragile, not mine. I'd rather pack books; I'm nervous about china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, fragile. That's why I want someone as careful as you on it. I'll handle the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wrap the plates while you put them in the boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely idea. I'll leave the boxes beside you and take the books downstairs. You'll have the whole kitchen to work in.

reason: Copy fragility labels as assignments, then warmly redirect B safer shared-work proposal into solo responsibility.
